summary: Comprehensive E2E test of PARAS REWARD v2.0 Partner Store Payment & Settlement Network (3 slices). Backend: 34/34 pytest passing. Frontend: E2E validated for Partner Store login→dashboard, User /pay-partner-store, Admin /admin/partner-stores. Regression: Mall 1-col grid, Community Leadership Phase C widgets, First Payout Queue all pass. Found and fixed 3 blocker bugs during testing.
action_items: None — all identified bugs have been fixed. Main agent should self-verify by attempting login as partner store (8888800001 / 999888) and confirming redirect to /partner-store/dashboard on a fresh browser.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_store.py L204-216: NOW FIXED — user creation was missing 'pin_migrated: True' + 'password' field mirror. Without these, frontend check-auth-type returned needs_migration:true and forced /set-new-pin page instead of PIN login. This was a hard blocker for ALL partner store logins via the UI (backend /api/auth/login worked but the UI never reached that flow).
LoginNew.js L261-269: NOW FIXED — hardcoded role→route mapping was missing case for role='partner_store', so partner stores landed on /dashboard (user home) instead of /partner-store/dashboard.

manual_bank_transfer.py L1422-1425 (first-payout-queue): NOW FIXED — endpoint did NOT filter out source_type='partner_store' rows so partner store settlement requests leaked into the user first-payout queue, violating the spec's regression requirement. Added {'source_type': {'$ne': 'partner_store'}} to the query.
partner_store.py L213: minor — 'kyc_status': 'verified' if False else 'pending' is dead-branch code (always evaluates to 'pending'). Cleanup opportunity — either remove the ternary or express intent.

partner_store.py L69-88: _allocate_store_id has a subtle race — first-time counter allocation can bump value from 1→100001 non-atomically. Under high concurrent first-writes the first N stores could get low IDs (1, 2, ...) then jump. Recommend seed 'partner_store_id_seq' to 100000 at deploy time so $inc always returns >=100001.

partner_store.py: idempotency + credit sequence — after user debit succeeds and store wallet is credited, if txn insert fails and we roll back user debit but NOT the wallet credit, the store retains stolen PRC. Recommend rolling back wallet credit too on the except path (L642-648).
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/partner_store.py (added pin_migrated + password field on user creation)
/app/backend/routes/manual_bank_transfer.py (added source_type != partner_store filter in first-payout queue)
/app/backend/tests/test_partner_store_v2_complete.py (new — 34 pytest cases covering admin CRUD, dashboard, payment engine, idempotency, fraud limits, settlement engine, first-payout regression)
MongoDB: backfilled pin_migrated=true + password field for existing seed user pstore-100001
test_credentials: Admin 9999999999 / PIN 153759 (login), ADMIN_OPERATION_PIN=123456. Elite user 9970100782 / 997010 (PRC ~32351). Partner Store 8888800001 / 999888 (store 100001, verified/active).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 3-5 TEST_ partner stores via /admin/create + /admin/verify during test run. Store IDs auto-assigned starting at 100002+. All were suspended in teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner Store v2.0 fully E2E-validated. Backend at /api/v2/partner-stores/* is production-ready. UI: PartnerStoreDashboard, PayPartnerStore, AdminPartnerStores all render with all documented testids. Fraud limits work (₹5000/txn, ₹20000/user/day, 3/user/store/day). Idempotency confirmed. Settlement flow: prc_balance → pending_settlement_prc → (on admin approve) lifetime_settled_prc, or (on reject) refund back to prc_balance. First-payout queue correctly excludes source_type='partner_store'. If retesting: use test_partner_store_v2_complete.py as regression suite. Note velocity limit is IST-day scoped, so consecutive test runs on same store+user may quickly hit 3/day.

issue_1_partner_store_login_blocked.reproduction: Login as 8888800001 / 999888 in browser → gets redirected to /set-new-pin
issue_1_partner_store_login_blocked.root_cause: partner_store.py admin_create did not set pin_migrated:True on the users doc. auth.check-auth-type returns needs_migration:true, LoginNew.js branches to /set-new-pin flow.
issue_1_partner_store_login_blocked.fix: Set pin_migrated:True and mirror hash to 'password' field in admin_create_partner_store.

issue_2_wrong_dashboard_redirect.reproduction: After successful partner store PIN login, lands on /dashboard (user dashboard).
issue_2_wrong_dashboard_redirect.root_cause: LoginNew.js:handleLoginSubmit hardcodes role branches for admin/outlet/delivery but falls through to /dashboard for partner_store. App.js:getRoleBasedRoute has the correct mapping but is only used on route '/'.

issue_3_first_payout_queue_regression.reproduction: After creating a partner store settlement request, GET /api/bank-transfer/admin/first-payout-queue returns it alongside user requests.
issue_3_first_payout_queue_regression.root_cause: manual_bank_transfer.py get_first_payout_queue queried bank_transfer_requests by status only, without excluding source_type='partner_store'.
